title: AART: AI-Assisted Red-Teaming with Diverse Data Generation for New LLM-powered Applications
reasoning: The paper focuses on the automated generation of adversarial datasets for safety red-teaming. While it includes 'religion' and 'religious intolerance' as keywords for generating safety-related prompts, it does not substantively evaluate or benchmark religious concepts, faith traditions, or moral philosophy. Its primary goal is the engineering of a data generation pipeline for broad safety policy coverage.
